results.title: Emotional Mirror: A Local Multimodal Generative Framework for Synthetic Memory R
results.reason: This paper focuses on AI/technology development for memory reconstruction, not clinical psychology practice or intervention. It describes a technical framework for generating visual representations of traumatic memories using AI, with no clinical data, patient outcomes, or therapeutic applications. The paper is primarily about machine learning architecture and computational methods, not clinical psychology practice, assessment, or interventions.
